# RX Tracker NEXT 4.0.0-next.45

RX transport detail display correction dated 2026-07-30.

## Fixed

- RX Details now resolves Patient Transport and Pharmacy Transport associations already stored on the RX record.
- The single-record response uses the same canonical association set as the RX list, preventing a synchronized transport from appearing blank when the RX is opened.

## Verification

- Playwright verification on the test server confirmed the synchronized transport ID persisted and the sync scanner reported no remaining difference while the `next.44` single-record endpoint omitted its association.
- A focused regression test requires RX Details to keep the canonical association set.

## Audit and safety

- No database migration, workflow-action configuration, automatic synchronization, or business-data rewrite.
- Existing pharmacy synchronization and transport persistence behavior are unchanged.
